notes: Read 25 Nov 2026 (UTC; 25–26 Nov China time). Firecrawl was out of credits; pages were fetched with curl / WebFetch and read as text. (1) PCBasic and Huaqiu are probably NOT independent: PCBasic's form says 'Panel by NextPCB' (NextPCB is Huaqiu's export brand) and both carry the identical 4-wire test text (min 100 CNY + 80 CNY/m²) and interleaving-paper text (50 CNY + 20 CNY/m²) — Huaqiu quote tooltip: '收费标准:四线低阻需要全流程热测筛查，测试慢，成本较高，最低收费100元，每平方米加多80元。' This corroborates the 4-wire +¥80/m² already used, but from the same price book. (2) PCBasic also prints a hole-density adder: 'For 4-layer and above, pricing is based on 100,000 holes per square meter. An additional charge of 4 RMB per 10,000 holes per square meter will apply.' (2-layer basis 80,000 holes/m²), and hole copper 20 µm setup 50 RMB/design + 10 RMB/m², 25 µm 100 + 25, 30 µm 150 + 50, 35 µm 200 + 100. (3) Guanzhongxin's guide also lists: IPC-6012 class III ~+20 %, halogen-free +30 %, lead-free HASL +30 CNY/m², plated half-holes +200 CNY/m², blind/buried +20 %, aspect ratio > 1:8 +20 %, Shengyi laminate ~10 % over KB, untaxed = taxed × 0.92. It is a SAMPLE-price factor table, undated (© 2020 footer). (4) Base-price context (not requested): JLC 2026-09-21 notice — single/double 410 CNY/m², 4-layer 460 CNY/m² (A1 laminate, 1.6 mm, 8 plies); JLC 2026-01-08 +20 CNY/m² on 2/4-layer FR4 batch; JLC lead-free HASL 30 CNY/m² (2026-08-24 notice); Huaqiu volume ladder (2024-09-18) lowest 220 CNY/m² double-sided, 410 CNY/m² 4-layer. (5) Not readable: jiepei.com (Aliyun captcha), dzsc.com showroom (WAF 405), JLC / Huaqiu / Jiepei online calculators (prices computed server-side; not 'published' lists). JLCPCB's board-thickness surcharge table exists only as an image. (6) No page gives automotive-volume (100k+ boards) adders; every figure here is a quick-turn / small-batch fab's list or a sample-price guide, so treat as an upper bound for volume production. (7) JLC ENIG prices are the whole ENIG charge per m², not the step from 1U to 2U; any subtraction is left to the caller.
